name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
